name: windowllm
description: Universal browser LLM API - giving users sovereignty over their AI

scripts.build:extension: npm run build --workspace=@windowllm/vault && npm run build:chrome --workspace=@windowllm/extension && cp packages/extension/manifest.json packages/extension/dist/ && cp -r packages/extension/icons packages/extension/dist/
scripts.build:extension:firefox: npm run build --workspace=@windowllm/vault && npm run build:firefox --workspace=@windowllm/extension && cp packages/extension/manifest.firefox.json packages/extension/dist/manifest.json && cp -r packages/extension/icons packages/extension/dist/
scripts.build:extension:safari: npm run build --workspace=@windowllm/vault && npm run build:safari --workspace=@windowllm/extension

author: WindowLLM Contributors
